Alyssa (Docs): Heads-up — linkcheck is failing on publish for PR #4821. Docusaurus complains about anchors for headings that include inline code/backticks. Build log snippet:

```
ERROR: Broken anchor: /docs/api/client#`version()` -> not found
  at checkAnchors (linkcheck.js:204)
  at async runAll (linkcheck.js:98)
```

Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :eyes:

Mike (Platform): Can you paste the offending heading markdown? Curious whether it's a mdx quirk or the slugifier.

Alyssa (Docs): It's in the client API page — heading is exactly:

```markdown
### `version()` client helper
```

And elsewhere we have links like `[client.version](/docs/api/client#\`version()\`)` which used to work but the slug generation now drops the backticks differently between build and linkcheck.

Jordan (DevEx): Ugh — this is a classic slug normalization mismatch. Quick options:
- add an explicit id: `### `version()` client helper {#version-client-helper}`
- or escape the code in the heading (replace backticks with HTML entity ```)
- or normalize slugs in the linkchecker CI step (strip backticks/punctuation before comparing)

Here's a tiny sed trick that normalizes headings in CI before running linkcheck (non-destructive, for CI only):

```bash
# in linkcheck step
perl -0777 -pe "s/^###\s+`([^`]+)`/### $1/gm" docs/**/*.mdx > /tmp/normalized_docs.mdx
# feed normalized_docs to slug generator/linkcheck
```

Priya (Eng): I can open a docs PR to add an explicit id to that heading — fastest path to unblocking the release. Will also add a short note in docs CONTRIBUTING about avoiding raw backticks in headings.

DocsBot: linkcheck/job-4821 finished — 16 broken anchors found across site. See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/teams/docs/4821

Mike (Platform): For long-term, we should decide on a canonical slug strategy. Can we pin the slugifier version or add a rehype plugin (rehype-slug with a custom slugify) in docusaurus config? That will keep builds/linkcheck aligned.

Jordan (DevEx): Agreed. I'll prototype a rehype-slug config that collapses non-alphanum and converts backticks to hyphens. If it looks safe I'll open an infra PR and run the full linkcheck suite.

Priya (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4830 — small patch: added `{#version-client-helper}` to the heading and updated the link to point at `#version-client-helper`. Also added a one-liner in CONTRIBUTING about heading ids. :shipit:

Alyssa (Docs): Merged and CI re-run — linkcheck now passes for the client page. Remaining failures were unrelated image path redirects, filing follow-ups. Thanks everyone! :+1:

Mike (Platform): Nice. Can we add a quick test to linkcheck that flags headings with inline code so writers avoid the pattern? Low friction and prevents regressions.

Jordan (DevEx): Good call. I'll add a grep-based lint in the docs lint job to warn on headings that contain backticks and suggest adding `{#...}` ids.

Priya (Eng): Adding the linter in my follow-up PR too, will keep it advisory first so we don't break old content.

Alyssa (Docs): Perfect — closing this thread. Thanks!
